name: Raspberry Pi OS (Pi 3 / 4 / 5)

imager.label: Raspberry Pi Imager (official)
imager.description: Free, official tool from Raspberry Pi. Picks the OS image for you, writes it to your SD card or USB drive, and pre-configures hostname, SSH, and WiFi before first boot.

alternativeTool.label: balenaEtcher
alternativeTool.description: Cross-platform image writer. Use this if you already have a .img file you want to write.

license: Various (Raspberry Pi OS components mostly GPL/MIT)
description: Full Linux OS install for Raspberry Pi 3, 4, or 5. Unlike a microcontroller, a Pi runs a complete operating system that lives on an SD card or USB drive — there is no browser flash for this. Use Raspberry Pi Imager to pick an OS, write it to your media, and boot the Pi for the first time.
